crossRefs.note: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian.…
They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and…
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of…
Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be…
Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned…
The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
crossRefs.keyword: translation; the original being uniformly Kishon

people.name: Jabin
people.line: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Sisera
people.line: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
translations.bsb: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
translations.kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
translations.asv: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
